faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MPSC LDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the MPSC Lower Division Clerk (LDC) recruitment is 12th October 2026. Ensure you submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the LDC post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate examination and possess a Diploma in Computer Application or an equivalent qualification. A typing speed of 30 words per minute is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to the LDC position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, the upper age limit is relaxable by up to 5 years for candidates belonging to Scheduled Tribe (ST) and Scheduled Caste (SC) categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the LDC post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Lower Division Clerk (LDC) post will be placed at Level - 4 in the Pay Matrix, as per the government norms.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the LDC post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the Lower Division Clerk (LDC) position in this recruitment drive by MPSC.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the MPSC Lower Division Clerk (LDC) recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official MPSC online portal.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection stages for the LDC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the MPSC LDC recruitment typically involves a Written Examination followed by Document Verification of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is advisable to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of MPSC?
faq.answer: The official website of the Mizoram Public Service Commission (MPSC) is mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in. You can visit this site for more information and to apply.
